title: Sitoo – försäljning live
description: Försäljning inkl. moms från Sitoo via sitoo-sync, jämfört med samma veckodag förra året och rekorddagen (readagar undantagna).

panels.title: Försäljning (inkl. moms)

targets.rawSql:
WITH r0 AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(SECOND, $__unixEpochFrom(), CAST('19700101' AS datetime2)) AS F,
         DATEADD(SECOND, $__unixEpochTo(),   CAST('19700101' AS datetime2)) AS T
), r1 AS (
  SELECT F, T,
         CAST(F AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'W. Europe Standard Time' AS datetime2(0)) AS FL,
         CAST(T AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'W. Europe Standard Time' AS datetime2(0)) AS TL
  FROM r0
), r AS (
  SELECT F, T, FL, TL, CAST(FL AS date) AS D,
         CASE WHEN DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DATEADD(DAY, -364, CAST(FL AS date))) <> DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, CAST(FL AS date))
               AND DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DATEADD(DAY, -371, CAST(FL AS date))) =  DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, CAST(FL AS date))
              THEN 371 ELSE 364 END AS N
  FROM r1
), rec AS (
  -- Rekorddagen: den hela dag före vald period med högst försäljning inkl. moms, readagar undantagna
  SELECT TOP 1 v.Dag, v.ForsaljningInklMoms AS Forsaljning
  FROM sitoo.vDagsforsaljning v CROSS JOIN r
  WHERE v.Dag < r.D AND v.ArReadag = 0
  ORDER BY v.ForsaljningInklMoms DESC
)
SELECT ISNULL(SUM(o.MoneyTotalGrossAll), 0) AS value FROM sitoo.Orders o CROSS JOIN r WHERE o.OrderDateLocal >= r.FL AND o.OrderDateLocal < r.TL

panels.description: Ordrarnas belopp inkl. moms i vald period. Returer räknas av.

panels.title: Samma dag förra året

  FROM r0

         CASE WHEN DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DATEADD(DAY, -364, CAST(FL AS date))) <> DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, CAST(FL AS date))
               AND DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DATEADD(DAY, -371, CAST(FL AS date))) =  DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, CAST(FL AS date))

SELECT CONCAT(CHOOSE(DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', DATEADD(DAY, -r.N, r.D)) % 7 + 1, 'Mån', 'Tis', 'Ons', 'Tor', 'Fre', 'Lör', 'Sön'), ' v', DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DATEADD(DAY, -r.N, r.D)),

FROM r

panels.title: Ackumulerad försäljning – i dag, förra året och rekorddagen

         DATEADD(SECOND, $__unixEpochTo(),   CAST('19700101' AS datetime2)) AS T
), r1 AS (
  SELECT F, T,
         CAST(F AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'W. Europe Standard Time' AS datetime2(0)) AS FL,
         CAST(T AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'W. Europe Standard Time' AS datetime2(0)) AS TL
  FROM r0
), r AS (
  SELECT F, T, FL, TL, CAST(FL AS date) AS D,
         CASE WHEN DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DATEADD(DAY, -364, CAST(FL AS date))) <> DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, CAST(FL AS date))
               AND DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, DATEADD(DAY, -371, CAST(FL AS date))) =  DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, CAST(FL AS date))
              THEN 371 ELSE 364 END AS N
  FROM r1
), rec AS (

  ORDER BY v.ForsaljningInklMoms DESC
), h AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, o.OrderDateLocal), 0) AS b, SUM(o.MoneyTotalGrossAll) AS v

SELECT TOP 25
  o.OrderDateUtc AS Tid,
  o.OrderId AS [Order],
  ISNULL(w.Name, CONCAT('Lager ', o.WarehouseId)) AS Lager,
  (SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM sitoo.OrderItems i WHERE i.OrderId = o.OrderId AND i.Sku IS NOT NULL) AS Artiklar,
  (SELECT STRING_AGG(p.Name, ', ') FROM sitoo.OrderPayments p WHERE p.OrderId = o.OrderId) AS Betalning,
  o.MoneyTotalGrossAll AS [Belopp inkl. moms]
FROM sitoo.Orders o
LEFT JOIN sitoo.Warehouses w ON w.SiteId = o.EshopId AND w.WarehouseId = o.WarehouseId
ORDER BY o.OrderId DESC
